def transform(g):
    import collections
    from itertools import product
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # separator lines: full rows/cols of a single non-bg color
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    rb=[i for i in range(h) if i not in sep_rows]
    cb=[j for j in range(w) if j not in sep_cols]
    # group into bands
    def bands(idx):
        out=[];cur=[idx[0]]
        for a,b in zip(idx,idx[1:]):
            if b==a+1: cur.append(b)
            else: out.append(cur);cur=[b]
        out.append(cur);return out
    rbands=bands(rb); cbands=bands(cb)
    # find pattern block: has non-bg
    pat=None
    for ri,rband in enumerate(rbands):
        for ci,cband in enumerate(cbands):
            if any(g[i][j]!=bg for i in rband for j in cband):
                pat=(ri,ci)
    pr,pc=rbands[pat[0]],cbands[pat[1]]
    ptile=[[g[i][j] for j in pc] for i in pr]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for ri,rband in enumerate(rbands):
        for ci,cband in enumerate(cbands):
            for i in rband:
                for j in cband:
                    out[i][j]=ptile[i-rband[0]][j-cband[0]]
    return out
